input.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts

The parser splits the uploaded file on "\n" only (`text.split("\n")`). Files exported from Windows tools use CRLF line endings, so each line (including the header) ends up with a trailing "\r". That stray character gets counted as part of the last column, which throws off the column count comparison and triggers "errors.rowShape" ("Malformed row...") on the very first data row. The parser needs to normalize/strip "\r" (e.g. split on /\r?\n/ or trim each line) before comparing column counts.

text: Likely bug in parser.ts splitting on "\n" without handling CRLF from Windows export, causing header/line mismatch (trailing \r). This is the file most responsible.
